statements.quote: I left at six and did not return to the building that evening.

exhibits.title: Visitor record · 18:42
exhibits.text: The desk visitor record has a signed entry: Casey Vale, arrival 18:42, that same evening.

win.confession: You’re right—I lied when I said I left at six and didn’t return that evening. I came back to the building at 18:42, and the visitor record shows that. I was afraid to admit I’d returned, so I denied it. But that only establishes I was there; it doesn’t mean I took the ledger.
